combat assault tank |designer= |manufacturer=[[Rothana Heavy Engineering]]''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' |line=[[TX-225 Occupier]] |model=TX-225 GAVr "Occupier" combat assault tank |type=[[Ground assault vehicle]]{{Databank|combat-assault-tank|combat assault tank}} |cost= |modifier= |sysmods= |length=Around 7.5 [[meter]]s{{EncyclopediaCite|Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order}} |width= |height=2 meters |mass= |max accel= |speed=75 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] |velocity= |engine=[[ADGT-1500 engine]] |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull=Depleted [[duranium]] composite armor |sensor= |target= |navigation= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=Twin [[Laser cannon]]s (3){{Rebels|The Occupation}} |complement= |bays= |escapepods= |crew=*[[Imperial combat assault tank commander|Commander]] (1) *[[Imperial combat assault tank pilot|Pilot]] (1) *[[Gunner]]/[[technician]] (1) |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity=[[Kyber crystal container]]s (3){{Rebels|Kindred}} |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |availability= |role=Ground assault |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Army]] }} {{Quote|We won't stand long against those tanks.|[[Garazeb Orrelios]]|}} The '''TX-225 GAVr "Occupier" combat assault tank''' was a [[hovertank]] [[ground assault vehicle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]. The secondary model of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]]'s [[TX-225 Occupier]] series, unlike its counterpart, the [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank|TX-225 GAVw]], the GAVr utilized [[repulsorlift]]s instead of treads as its main propulsion system. It was deployed on [[Lothal]]. {{Veh-stub}} ==History== In [[1 BBY]],{{RebelsDate|405}} Imperial combat assault tanks were deployed on [[Lothal]] during the Empire's occupation on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world. They assisted in hunting down and capturing members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Lothal resistance group|resistance]] cell.{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} ==Behind the scenes== The TX-225 GAVr Occupier hovertank was initially created and developed for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. However, the idea of a hovertank was abandoned in early stages of production, changed instead to the non-repulsorlift [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank|TX-225 GAVw]]. Despite this, the former name was mistakenly used in several toy lines.{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/809975501527728128|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@maerj2000 very early on it was a hover tank but that changed.
